explicit_assumptions: The modeled customer pays one equity-share assessment on each executed side; member assessments do not establish actual customer pass-through.
Use zero commission for the frozen direct-API equity research model. An actual account agreement has not been verified.

Accrue each fee type by account-day, cap each one-fill sell order's TAF first, round each cumulative fee type upward to cents, and debit only the increment. This preserves the frozen parent convention.
Deduct accrued fees from cash and net realized P&L at confirmed fill time. EOD posting is not a second expense or cash debit.
Attribute the cumulative rounding increment to the campaign causing it. Campaign penny allocation depends on causal order; account-day totals do not.
Apply the July CAT reduction on the trade date under the May 29 announced schedule. Later filings and confirmation validate the historical assessment, but are not pre-trade observations.

No separate venue, off-exchange cost-recovery, clearing, financing, routing, tax, subscription or optional service charges are inferred from these member rates. Broker statement equivalence is unverified.
